interpretation.controls: The two families' null controls remain separate. Individual results need not equal .5 or .05.
interpretation.covariance_comparator: Chosen for these Gaussian mechanisms; no universal-superiority or real-world-transfer claim.
interpretation.method_difference: Left method minus right method on the same condition, seed and test rows.
interpretation.pairing: Compute differences per seed first, then their mean and SD; never subtract arm SDs.
interpretation.performance: Full-precision per-seed metrics; every planned result included.
interpretation.principal_comparison: Ledoit-Wolf minus fixed-reference COPOD at dependence_rho0p8, with every other condition retained.
interpretation.scope: Fixed 10,000 rows, 20 features, 5% positives and planned Gaussian settings; no additional dimensions tested.
interpretation.scoring_access: Batch COPOD uses train and test features; fixed COPOD and Ledoit-Wolf use training features only.
interpretation.sd: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across ten data seeds; not a confidence interval.
interpretation.sign_counts: Descriptive exact signs of paired differences; no hypothesis tests or equivalence claims.
interpretation.strength_difference: Non-null strength minus its own family's null control, with the same seed and method.
interpretation.tail_counts: Zero-tail cells and distinct affected rows are separate; already-at-floor probabilities are not replacements.
interpretation.timing: Original descriptive times retained in all_metrics; no speed benchmark or timing ranking.
